new_problems: The bench-api stand-in critic sent the Swiss task back 4 times although the daemon was restarted with --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_REJECT_TIMES=1 (/tmp/frbench/fix-d1116-budget-all/steps/after2-budget-all.json: 'Needs your decision: tried 4 times'). Either restart-daemon.mjs --env does not reach the role player, or REJECT_TIMES is not read on the bench-api path. This affects bench walks only, not the product.

The paused card's Continue explanation reads 'starts a session that goes on from where it stopped' even when the work is done and only the review waits (/tmp/frbench/fix-d1116-budget-all/steps/12-after2-06-inbox.png). A wording polish for d1109-oversize-pause's card words, which this area must not touch apart from the room clause.

Bench-only caveat (spec): FORERUNNER_BENCH_USAGE and FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_USAGE add input tokens after the precheck, so a run they inflate can pass its work cap. The real-daemon W15-14 world showed the same with its injected 145k-token usage: 'stopped at its budget of CHF 0.15, less the CHF 0.04 kept for its review, after spending CHF 0.12' (the work cap was CHF 0.11). The task's own budget was not passed. The evidence that no budget is passed comes from the composed tests (task-budget-all.test.ts).
notes_for_other_areas: RunResult.error.estimateUsdMicro (agent/loop.ts) and ReviewRefusal.estimateUsdMicro: the refused call's estimate, stored on the card.

CriticPort.reviewCallUsdMicro(task, specialist?) -> {worstUsdMicro, floorUsdMicro, maxEffort} (loop/ports.ts), built on CriticService.reviewCallUsdMicro(tier, projectSettings) and REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ALLOWANCE_TOKENS = 8,000 (critic.ts).
TaskReviewRequest.onCost and .budgetUsdMicro (append-only): every critic call is booked on the task; the review is capped at the task's budget less its figure.

PlanItem.reviewRoomUsdMicro and Planner.reviewPartOf?(task) (runner.ts); workRunCapOf(task, specialistLimit, reviewRoom) -> {capUsdMicro, roomUsdMicro, source} (executor.ts); BudgetStop.roomUsdMicro; PausedWork.estimateLeftUncappedUsdMicro.

Budget card change_card fields: needs_usd_micro (what one Continue must add at the task's budget) and room_usd_micro (what the run kept for its review); continueUsdMicro(task, stop, rate, {needsUsdMicro}).

EstimateResult.reviewUsdMicro / reviewRatio; exported reviewPartUsdMicro(task, floor?, starts?) and REVIEW_STARTING_ESTIMATES_USD_MICRO {1: 30_000, 2: 90_000, 3: 300_000} (estimates/model.ts): the one place for the owner to tune the review part. EstimateModelOptions.reviewFloor; estimate snapshot version 3; samples kept by task id; onTaskFinished fires at the task's close; the daemon calls refreshEstimates() before GET /projects/:id/start-check and before pricing a plan card.

non_blocking:
Flaky test from an earlier sub-run, not from this branch: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts:20525 (d1109-selftasks-run, run C, "the card in the Inbox names the project ... after a restart ...").
- It passes alone and fails in full-file runs: 3 of 6 on the branch, 1 of 3 on base at 136d4f6.
- Why: composeWithRolePlayer uses a ShiftedClock fixed at 2026-03-05T08:00, which starts again from that time at the second compose. runOrder ranks by priority, then created_at. So whether 'Check that the links work', created after the restart, sorts before 'Send the logo', created before it, depends on a few milliseconds.
- It will likely fail on CI sometimes. Its owner (C4) or the session lead should give the second compose a later clock, or assert the order from the stored created_at.
